headline: Three Contested Fronts See Fresh Base Shifts
war_summary: The latest ledger shows fresh changes on several contested fronts. Mooring County now lists six Colonial, five Warden and one neutral base, against eight, four and none in the previous edition; nine base events came in the latest two hours, 53 over the day. Linn Mercy stands at seven Colonial, two Warden and two neutral, compared with nine, one and one previously, and logged eight events in two hours. Weathered Expanse is now evenly split between three Colonial and three Warden bases, with three neutral; it recorded 13 events in the latest two hours and 57 in 24. Callum’s Cape lists five Colonial, one Warden and one neutral base, with two events in the latest two hours and 19 over the day. Marban Hollow’s count remains four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral; its 12 daily events include just one in the latest six hours and none in the latest two. Elsewhere the base ledger is largely quiet. No victor is declared, and the required tally remains 34 victory towns.
